atomicity_route.conflict_note: Design concept Q14 and the reviewability budget record three ordered slices. That is not a contradiction of one-navigable-PR: the classifier distinguishes one PR from several, while the slice division fixes review order inside the work. split-PR would mean three separate pull requests; the recorded decision is one specification implemented and reviewed as three ordered slices, with roadmap Work Package A kept intact as slice 1.

layer_plan.reason: Layer planner runs only when the atomicity route is exactly split-PR. Route is one-navigable-PR, so planning is skipped and the route context is carried forward.

pr_marker_plan.reason: Whole-feature reviewable LOC is 1858, which exceeds the 800-LOC block threshold, while each slice is under it (735 / 533 / 590) and total files (23) are under the 25-file block. This is a size-only condition with a committed slice division, so it is a marker-planning input rather than a manual re-slicing stop.

ordered_markers.intact_reason: The roadmap independently requires Work Package A remain a single reviewable unit; it must not be subdivided to fit a threshold.

authoritative_figures.source: Plan-phase re-derivation from the real design; supersedes the roadmap's recorded 0 production files and the spec's 6-10 projection.

pr_marker_plan.estimator_caveat: Do not rely on estimate-reviewable-loc or a tasks-count heuristic here. The LOC estimator reports projected 0 and production 0 because its heuristic keys on path prefixes and JavaScript extensions and matches no Python in this repository. A tasks-mode heuristic of 86 tasks by 40 lines is likewise a false positive. Neither may be read as evidence that this change is small, and neither may trigger a Work Package A split.

measured_trajectory.note: The Plan-phase estimate of 1858 authored logic LOC across ALL three slices is already exceeded by slice-1 harness code alone (2557) with US2, US3 and US4 unwritten. Total files changed (33) already exceeds the 25-file block. The estimate was low; these measured figures supersede it.
measured_trajectory.consequence: Slice 1 will exceed the 800-LOC block on its own. The roadmap independently requires Work Package A stay intact, so slice 1 MUST NOT be subdivided to fit the threshold. This is a size-only condition with committed, operator-ratified slice evidence, which the boundary treats as a marker-planning input rather than a manual re-slicing stop. Expect the final gate to need marker-based emission and possibly a typed size exception for slice 1; that is an operator decision, not something to paper over.
measured_trajectory.production_budget_status: on track - still 0 shipped files; the single shipped materializer arrives in US2

tasks_phase_reviewability.deferral_reason: The installed runner supports reviewability-gate in setup mode only; tasks mode is deferred and must not be invoked as an active helper.
fallback_evidence_chain: Setup-mode gate recorded at scaffold: status warn, pass true, 0 blockers, 1 warning (primary surfaces 5 over warn threshold 1).
Plan-phase authoritative gate re-run: status warn, pass true, 0 blockers, exit 0, reviewable_loc 735, production_files 1, total_files 23, primary_surface_count 1.
Operator-ratified split decision recorded in the design concept (Q14) and the spec's Reviewability Budget: one specification, three ordered slices, Work Package A intact.

final_reviewability_gate.verdict: Size-only block against both the 800-LOC and 25-file thresholds. NOT a correctness block: no malformed or stale marker state, no failed verification, no invalid packet, no unsafe output, no non-size safety finding. Current marker evidence exists, so this proceeds to marker-based emission rather than a manual re-slicing stop.
final_reviewability_gate.operator_decision_required: Slice 1 exceeds the 800-LOC block on its own and the roadmap requires Work Package A stay intact, so it cannot be subdivided to fit. A typed size exception is needed. The authored production surface is a single file; the overrun is entirely repository-only harness, generated artifacts, and specification documents, which the constitution deliberately keeps outside the shipped payload.
final_reviewability_gate.not_a_reslicing_stop_because: The committed evidence chain is current: setup-mode gate pass-with-warning, plan-phase authoritative re-run pass-with-warning and zero blockers, and an operator-ratified three-slice division. The boundary treats a valid current size-only block with marker evidence as a marker-planning input.
